summary: A location near the courts and a named lawyer are strengths, but stray code on the page and an email form with no send button appear to cost you enquiries.

findings.problem: Stray text appears on the page, including '}}', '__MORE ABOUT US' and 'Hidden fields' beside the contact form.
findings.cost: Leftover code makes a law firm look unfinished.
findings.fix: A clean page with no leftover code.

findings.problem: The email us section lists Name, Email and Message but appears to show no submit button, and no WhatsApp number is listed.
findings.cost: Clients who want to message you cannot be sure the form works.
findings.fix: A tested form with a clear send button and WhatsApp.

findings.problem: The firm appears as Almushiri Law Firm, Al-Mushiri Law and Almushiri Law Office, and the main phone differs from Ahmed Al Mushiri's line.
findings.cost: Changing names and numbers weaken trust.
findings.fix: One firm name and clear contact lines.

findings.problem: The hero slogan repeats three times, and the page says Our legal team have years of experience but shows only one lawyer profile and no case results.
findings.cost: Repeated lines and thin proof weaken the firm's authority.
findings.fix: A full team page and case summaries.

redesign: A clean page and a tested contact form with WhatsApp.
One firm name and clear contact lines.
A full team page, credentials and case summaries.
